Lake Hartwell|SC.summary: Level is USGS 02187010 parameter 00062 (datum not declared by the parameter); reference is the CWMS Hartwell Top of Conservation (location vertical-datum NGVD29). On 35 overlapping daily values the USGS 00062 series minus the CWMS NGVD29 series is -0.12 ft mean, 0.06 ft SD (range -0.22 to +0.07); NAVD88 would be offset about -0.32 ft (CWMS vertical-datum-info). Lake Brain also stamps datum NGVD29 on the live state and re-checks the CWMS overlap (flag at 0.10 ft).

evidence.says: vertical-datum NGVD29; timeseries vertical-datum-info native NGVD-29, NAVD-88 offset -0.3246 (estimate)
USGS 02187010 agrees with the CWMS daily pool, median absolute deviation 0.09 ft

Lake Hartwell|SC.caveat: CWMS Top of Conservation is 660 ft only in summer (about April to mid-October); winter guide is 656 ft. The shift is relative to 660.
